canonical_english_titles: When the stone was sealed by the Jews
When Thou didst submit unto death, O Life Immortal
Let the heavens rejoice
Having learned the radiant proclamation of the Resurrection
Let us the faithful hymn and worship the Word
The angelic powers were upon Thy tomb
By Thy Cross Thou didst destroy death
From on high didst Thou descend, O Compassionate One
Christ is risen from the dead

canonical_english_titles: As Gabriel proclaimed unto thee, O Virgin
All beyond thought, all most glorious are thy mysteries
Thee who mediated the salvation of our race
The mystery hidden from all eternity
Rejoice, impassable gate of the Lord
O thou who wast called blessed in the Gospels
As the treasury of our resurrection
Thou who for our sake wast born of the Virgin

canonical_english_titles: Universal glory
